updates.title_zh: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
updates.title_en: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特公开敦促参议院在结束八月休会后通过CLARITY法案，警告若不通过将发出美国数字资产领导力衰退的信号。
updates.what_changed_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly urged the Senate to pass the CLARITY Act upon returning from August recess, warning that failure would send a signal of declining American leadership in digital assets.
